already_exposed: one prospective 2026-08-06 seconds morphology with no outcome or order authority
not_exposed: P-006 selection-window entry or exit outcomes

frozen_minute_skeleton.physical_volume_role: attention and seriousness only; never direction
frozen_minute_skeleton.volume_baseline: SPY opening one-minute volume divided by the per-minute equivalent median of the two strictly completed preopen five-minute bars
frozen_minute_skeleton.direction: XSP and SPY must agree on both path from the session open and the current one-minute body
frozen_minute_skeleton.slow_front: SPY fifteen-minute slope, velocity, and acceleration computed only from strictly completed full24 five-minute bars

slow_front_classes.CONTINUATION: direction-adjusted slope and velocity are positive
slow_front_classes.PIVOT_REPAIR: direction-adjusted slope is nonpositive while velocity and acceleration are positive

frozen_minute_skeleton.authority_bind: at least 10x physical volume plus joint XSP/SPY direction plus CONTINUATION or PIVOT_REPAIR

tradeable_mechanisms.PERSISTENT_DRIVE: 12x or higher, three consecutive same-direction one-minute observations, no confirmed velocity crest, and CONTINUATION
tradeable_mechanisms.CREST_REACCELERATION: 12x or higher, velocity crest, opposite recoil while session path survives, renewed same-direction acceleration, and CONTINUATION or PIVOT_REPAIR
tradeable_mechanisms.AUTHORITATIVE_HANDOFF: 12x or higher, two consecutive opposite observations, equal-or-higher volume authority, opposite session path, and opposite slow-front acceptance

frozen_minute_skeleton.entry_clock: the open immediately following the completed signal minute

next_step_law.if_count_passes: freeze one compact economic composition over Year-1 and Year-2 only; cells may use only the declared mechanism, volume-level, slow-front, and outcome-blind true-range morphology
